FFmpeg core 0.12.10 — licences and corresponding sources

The optional browser AAC converter uses unmodified @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10. Its GPL-enabled FFmpeg WebAssembly program is distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later. The program runs in a separately loaded Worker. The application retains its existing MIT licence.

Full GPL version 2 licence · GPL version 3 · Linked-library and runtime notices · Upstream binding/build MIT notice

The source archives below are supplied from the same location as the binaries. They contain FFmpeg, all linked libraries, Emscripten runtime sources, SDL2, and the original compilation and binding scripts. The upstream release is v12.15, commit 71aa99d37c02a7b4c435275ca9ef50e612f6efa1. Detailed provenance and rebuild instructions · Manifest · SHA-256 checksums · Local-source build helper

Download all source archives and metadata together with the build helper. With Python 3.12+, run python3 rebuild.py --prepare /tmp/ffmpeg-core-rebuild, then run make prd in that directory with Docker Buildx and Make installed. Compiler and OS build tools are obtained normally; the supplied FFmpeg and library source snapshots are used locally.
